function leetVariants(s) {
  const out = [{ str: s, subs: 0 }];
  for (const map of [LEET_A, LEET_B]) {
    let subs = 0; let str = '';
    for (const ch of s) { if (map[ch] !== undefined) { str += map[ch]; subs++; } else str += ch; }
    if (subs > 0 && !out.some((o) => o.str === str && o.subs === subs)) out.push({ str, subs });
  }
  return out;
}

const binom = (n, k) => { let r = 1; for (let i = 1; i <= k; i++) r = (r * (n - k + i)) / i; return r; };
function caseMult(s) {
  const U = (s.match(/[A-Z]/g) || []).length; const L = (s.match(/[a-z]/g) || []).length;
  if (U === 0) return 1;
  if (/^[A-Z][^A-Z]+$/.test(s) || /^[^a-z]*[A-Z]+[^a-z]*$/.test(s) && L === 0 || /^[^A-Z]+[A-Z]$/.test(s)) return 2;
  let sum = 0; for (let k = 1; k <= Math.min(U, L); k++) sum += binom(U + L, k);
  return Math.max(2, sum);
}

The Caesar and Vigenere ciphers behind the Flag Lab workbench. Excerpt of the real file.

export function caesar(text, shift) {
  const s = ((shift % 26) + 26) % 26;
  return [...text].map((ch) => {
    const c = ch.charCodeAt(0);
    if (c >= A && c <= A + 25) return String.fromCharCode(((c - A + s) % 26) + A);
    if (c >= a && c <= a + 25) return String.fromCharCode(((c - a + s) % 26) + a);
    return ch;
  }).join("");
}
export const rot13 = (t) => caesar(t, 13);

export function vigenere(text, key, decrypt = true) {
  const k = key.toUpperCase().replace(/[^A-Z]/g, "");
  if (!k) return text;
  let i = 0;
  return [...text].map((ch) => {
    const c = ch.charCodeAt(0), up = c >= A && c <= A + 25, lo = c >= a && c <= a + 25;
    if (!up && !lo) return ch;
    const sh = k.charCodeAt(i++ % k.length) - A, base = up ? A : a;
    return String.fromCharCode((((c - base + (decrypt ? -sh : sh)) % 26) + 26) % 26 + base);
  }).join("");
}

Pairing uses SRP, so the PIN never crosses the network. The hashing helpers and verifier, excerpt of the real file.

    static byte[] sha(byte[]... parts) {
        try {
            MessageDigest d = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
            for (byte[] p : parts) d.update(p);
            return d.digest();
        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(e);
        }
    }

    /** Big-endian, left-padded to 256 bytes. */
    static byte[] pad(BigInteger n) {
        byte[] raw = n.toByteArray();
        int off = Math.max(0, raw.length - SIZE), len = raw.length - off;
        byte[] out = new byte[SIZE];
        System.arraycopy(raw, off, out, SIZE - len, len);
        return out;
    }

    static byte[] ascii(String s) { return s.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8); }

    public static BigInteger verifier(byte[] salt, String pin) {
        BigInteger x = new BigInteger(1, sha(salt, sha(ascii("imirror:" + pin))));
        return G.modPow(x, N);
    }

Finding straight lines in a photo with a Hough transform, to judge the horizon. Excerpt of the real file.

/** Hough transform restricted to each edge pixel's own gradient direction. Returns the strongest straight lines. */
function findLines(img) {
  const { w, h } = img, g = boxBlur(luma(img), w, h, 1), { gx, gy, mag } = sobel(g, w, h);
  const thr = Math.max(percentile(mag, 0.92), 40), diag = Math.hypot(w, h), nR = Math.ceil(diag) * 2 + 1, off = Math.ceil(diag);
  const acc = new Float32Array(180 * nR), cnt = new Float32Array(180 * nR), cs = [], sn = [];
  for (let t = 0; t < 180; t++) { cs.push(Math.cos(t * RAD)); sn.push(Math.sin(t * RAD)); }
  for (let y = 1; y < h - 1; y++) for (let x = 1; x < w - 1; x++) {
    const i = y * w + x, m = mag[i]; if (m < thr) continue;
    let th = Math.round(Math.atan2(gy[i], gx[i]) / RAD); th = ((th % 180) + 180) % 180;
    for (let d = -6; d <= 6; d++) {
      const t = (th + d + 180) % 180, rho = Math.round(x * cs[t] + y * sn[t]) + off;
      acc[t * nR + rho] += m; cnt[t * nR + rho]++;
    }
  }

How the detective game builds its list of known people, places and objects, so it can recognise them in what you type. Excerpt of the real file.

function reg(list, id, phrases, type) {
  for (const p of phrases) {
    const phraseToks = tokens(p);
    if (!phraseToks.length) continue;
    registry.push({ type, id, phrase: p, len: phraseToks.length, chars: p.length });
  }
}
for (const [id, p] of Object.entries(PEOPLE)) reg(PERSON_PHRASES, id, p.names, 'person');
for (const [id, p] of Object.entries(PLACES)) reg(PLACE_PHRASES, id, p.names, 'place');
for (const [id, o] of Object.entries(OBJECTS)) reg(OBJECT_PHRASES, id, o.names, 'object');
